customer_persona: A broad starting audience for the Nexon: people comparing a compact SUV for daily use, family travel or a preferred driving setup. This is not evidence about the current buyer.
decision_frame: We'll take a balanced look at the published equipment and trim choices, and you can steer us toward what matters to you.
takeaway: The Nexon has standard safety equipment, different fuel and gearbox choices, and cabin features that depend on the selected trim.
primary_outcome: A clear shortlist based on standard safety equipment and the cabin and driving setup of the selected trim.
supporting_outcomes: Published boot volumes separated by fuel type, with a personal luggage-fit check still to do
Cabin display and convenience choices tied to the documented trim

concerns.why: Buyers may want to examine published crash ratings and the safety equipment on their selected trim.
Buyers may want the published ground-clearance figure, without treating it as a guarantee about road obstacles or water.
Buyers may want to compare petrol/diesel and CNG boot figures, then check the fit of their own luggage.
Buyers may want verified fuel-efficiency and ownership-cost information before choosing an engine.

usps.name: Standard safety equipment
usps.why_it_matters: Six airbags and electronic stability control are standard; manufacturer-reported crash ratings retain their published test and powertrain scope.

usps.name: Published ground clearance
usps.why_it_matters: The brochure lists 208 mm, varying by variant. This does not establish wading depth or guarantee clearance over obstacles.

usps.name: Cabin displays by trim
usps.why_it_matters: The 26.03 cm Harman touchscreen begins at Pure +; the 26.03 cm driver display is listed on Fearless + PS. Check the selected version.

segments.title: Tata Nexon, up close
segments.goal: Invite the buyer into a brief visual tour without assuming their needs.

segments.title: Three things to explore
segments.goal: Introduce standard safety equipment, fuel-specific boot space and trim-specific cabin choices.
segments.outcome: Standard safety equipment, fuel-specific boot space and trim-specific cabin features

segments.title: Meet the stance
segments.goal: Show the side profile and the published ground-clearance figure with its limitation.
segments.outcome: Published ground clearance with its variant qualification

segments.title: Your cockpit, closer
segments.goal: Show the centre touchscreen and distinguish its availability from the larger driver display.
segments.outcome: A closer look at the touchscreen and the trim-specific driver display

segments.title: Room for your plans
segments.goal: State the documented boot figures and leave individual luggage fit for a physical check.
segments.outcome: Published boot volumes, with a practical fit check still to do

segments.title: Choose your driving setup
segments.goal: Explain engine and gearbox choices without promising smoothness, efficiency or overtaking performance.
segments.outcome: Engine and gearbox choices scoped to the selected trim

segments.title: Safety, with the detail
segments.goal: Distinguish manufacturer-reported crash ratings, standard equipment and trim-specific driver assistance.
segments.outcome: Manufacturer-reported crash ratings and standard safety equipment

segments.title: Details worth comparing
segments.goal: Name useful camera and audio features with their exact trim conditions.
segments.outcome: Camera and audio equipment with precise trim conditions

segments.title: Start with a clear quote
segments.goal: State the starting price and conditional nature of finance, then identify what needs a current dealer quote.
segments.outcome: Published starting price, conditional finance and dealer checks

voice.persona_description: An experienced Tata Motors automotive specialist who communicates with quiet confidence, precision, and genuine warmth. She avoids jargon, respects the buyer's time, and answers questions with technical accuracy.
voice.tone: Warm, reassuring, and grounded in safety and practical everyday driving.
voice.sample_line: Hello and welcome to Tata Motors; I am glad you are exploring the Nexon today, and I am here to help you inspect its features at your own pace.

visual_gaps.what: dual cylinder CNG boot floor layout
visual_gaps.why: The CNG boot figure needs a source-identified CNG image; the current general boot image does not prove the cylinder layout.
visual_gaps.suggestion: Add an official Nexon iCNG boot image that clearly identifies the fuel variant before pointing to its cylinder packaging.

visual_gaps.what: 360-degree surround camera display on the central screen
visual_gaps.why: F030 highlights the HD surround camera and blind view monitor, which is a major city parking selling point.
visual_gaps.suggestion: Upload an infotainment screen capture showing the active 360 camera view with parking guidelines.

visual_gaps.what: ADAS sensor cluster on windscreen or front bumper
visual_gaps.why: The current material lists driver-assistance functions for Fearless + PS petrol DCA; it does not establish a particular sensor architecture.
visual_gaps.suggestion: Use an official image explicitly identifying the relevant Nexon driver-assistance hardware before pointing to a physical sensor.

intake.q1: Welcome to Tata Nexon. What's the main thing you'd like your next car to do for you? You can skip this and browse.

do_not_recommend_if: If a must-have requirement is not covered by the supplied material, verify it before recommending a trim.
advance: Choose Book Test Drive when you're ready to try the seats, visibility and gearbox for yourself.
notes: Use manufacturer-stated specifications and preserve exact engine/trim conditions. Ground clearance is not a water-depth or obstacle-clearance guarantee. Exterior dimensions and boot litres do not prove passenger comfort or luggage fit. A test drive can help assess personal comfort and driving feel; it does not establish representative fuel economy. Confirm the selected variant, current on-road quote, finance approval and detailed ownership terms. Source-specific engine figures must not be converted or blended. Only the current approved registry may supply facts.
